newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota Europe plant to start by early next century.
newsitem.headline: Toyota Europe plant to start by early next century.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Tuesday it aims to start production at its new European factory by early next century.

A Toyota spokesman quoted company president Hiroshi Okuda as saying at an informal meeting with reporters on Monday that the company will select a location for the new plant next year and aims to start production at the beginning of the next century., The Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily reported on Tuesday that Japan's largest automaker aims to start production at the new European factory by the end of 2001.
The paper said that the company is considering producing 1,300 cc Starlet cars at the new plant.
It also reported that Okuda will visit several possible sites for the new factory when he visits Europe in early May to attend a meeting of executives of Toyota's European subsidiaries.
The spokesman, however, declined to confirm the report. The company said earlier that it plans to boost European sales to 600,000 cars by 2000 from 420,000 in 1996.
